candidates: When bumping a dependency version, update all version references consistently in every affected `package.json` — both the `resolutions` block and any `devDependencies` entries must match. Leaving stale devDependency entries that differ from the resolutions pin causes confusion and can break builds if the resolutions block is ever removed.

In `scripts/ci/utils/helpers.ts`, the shared `playwright.install` helper should not hardcode a specific browser name (e.g., `chromium`). Omit the browser argument so Playwright installs its full default browser set; this avoids the helper silently skipping Firefox/WebKit if those projects are re-enabled in the future.

In `scripts/ci/utils/helpers.ts`, the `--with-deps` flag in `playwright.install` is Linux-only (it installs OS-level browser system dependencies). Because this helper is also invoked by Windows sandbox jobs in `scripts/ci/sandboxes.ts`, the flag must be made configurable (e.g., a `withDeps` boolean parameter defaulting to `true`). Pass `{ withDeps: false }` from any Windows callsites to avoid failures, since Windows runners require no additional system dependency installation.
